title: Irreducible closed subsets of an open subspace correspond to those of the space meeting it
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $U\subseteq X$ an open subset with the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Let $\mathcal I_U(X)$ be the set of irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components] closed subsets $Z\subseteq X$ with $Z\cap U\neq\emptyset$, and $\mathcal I(U)$ the set of irreducible closed subsets of the space $U$. Then for $Z\in\mathcal I_U(X)$ the set $Z\cap U$ belongs to $\mathcal I(U)$, and the map $\mathcal I_U(X)\to\mathcal I(U)$, $Z\mapsto Z\cap U$, is a bijection, with inverse $T\mapsto\overline T$ (the closure of $T$ in $X$), such that for $Z,Z'\in\mathcal I_U(X)$ one has $Z\subseteq Z'$ if and only if $Z\cap U\subseteq Z'\cap U$. In particular $Z\subsetneq Z'$ implies $Z\cap U\subsetneq Z'\cap U$.
